deck.audience: frontend engineers and engineering managers tracking JavaScript ecosystem trends

brief.title: 2024 JavaScript Rising Stars: Top Projects and Ecosystem Shifts
brief.one_liner: A data-driven overview of the most-starred JavaScript projects in 2024, highlighting the dominance of shadcn/ui, the rise of htmx, and major framework evolutions.
brief.goal: Equip the audience with a clear understanding of which JavaScript projects gained the most traction in 2024, why they succeeded, and what ecosystem trends to watch heading into 2025.

slides.title: 2024 JavaScript Rising Stars: The Year's Hottest Projects by GitHub Stars
slides.objective: Cover slide introducing the 9th edition of JavaScript Rising Stars, noting the methodology (GitHub stars added in 2024 from Best of JS curated list).

slides.title: shadcn/ui Leads Overall with +38k Stars, Followed by Excalidraw and AFFiNE
slides.objective: Present a ranked bar chart or table of the top 10 most-starred projects overall, showing star counts. Emphasize the gap between #1 and the rest.

slides.title: shadcn/ui: Copy-Paste Components Win for the Second Consecutive Year
slides.objective: Detail shadcn/ui's year-over-year growth trajectory (N/A through 2022, 39.5k in 2023, 38.0k in 2024) using the yearly trend chart. Highlight key 2024 features: Charts, Themes, Blocks, Sidebar, new CLI with multi-framework support. Reference figure_1.jpg and figure_2.jpg for trend visuals.

slides.title: htmx Overtakes React as #1 Front-end Framework by Stars Added
slides.objective: Show the front-end frameworks ranking with htmx (+16.8k), React (+14.2k), Svelte (+6.1k), Vue (+5.9k), Angular (+3.5k). Explain htmx's HTML-extension philosophy and React 19's long-awaited release with Server Components.

slides.title: React Ecosystem: shadcn/ui, Excalidraw, and Payload Dominate
slides.objective: Display the top 5 React ecosystem projects (shadcn/ui +38k, Excalidraw +27k, Payload +14.4k, Magic UI +13.2k, Next.js +12.1k). Discuss React's evolution toward a full-stack framework specification.

slides.title: Vue Ecosystem Flourishes: Nuxt, PrimeVue, and Slidev Lead Growth
slides.objective: Present the Vue ecosystem top 5 (Nuxt +6.2k, PrimeVue +5.4k, Slidev +4.7k, shadcn-vue +4.1k, VitePress +3.7k). Note Vue 3.5 reactivity rework and the alien-signals approach.

slides.title: AI Tools, Desktop Apps, and Browser-Based Innovation Shape 2024
slides.objective: Highlight cross-cutting themes: AI-powered projects (Flowise +14.5k, n8n +17k), desktop via Tauri (+15.9k), browser capabilities (PGlite, WebVM), and the BaaS trend (Supabase +14.5k). Use a thematic grouping visual.

slides.title: Key Takeaways: What 2024 Tells Us About JavaScript's Future
slides.objective: Summarize 4-5 actionable takeaways: (1) component ownership model wins over imports, (2) HTML-first approaches gain serious traction, (3) React is becoming a framework specification, (4) AI integration is now table stakes, (5) Vue's UI library ecosystem is a sign of maturity. End with forward-looking implications for 2025.
